answer:
Among the concrete documentation formats for ML-enabled system projects, the two least-used are **BDD_Scenarios** and **MLCanvas**, with 4/194 (2.06%) and 15/194 (7.73%) of the 194 Q10-answering respondents indicating so (95% percentile bootstrap CIs, B = 10,000: BDD_Scenarios [0.515%, 4.124%]; MLCanvas [4.124%, 11.856%]). Vision_Document and Goal_Models are tied at the next position (rank 3‐4) at 29 quotations each (14.95% of N = 194; 10.51% of N = 276), matching the question's cited ~10.13% figure under N = 276.

Caveat: the question-stated 10.13% (95% CI [9.926%, 10.333%]) and 4.366% (95% CI [4.231%, 4.501%]) values cannot be reproduced exactly from this CSV alone — those CI half-widths are only ~0.13–0.20 percentage points, far narrower than what a non-parametric bootstrap on N = 194 (or even N = 276) yields (SE ≈ 2.15 pp at p = 0.10 for n = 194, so a normal-approximation half-width is ~3.5 pp). The cited numbers almost certainly come from the source paper's specific stratified or weighted bootstrap (N, stratification factors, and weighting are not staged in the supplied artifacts), and the survey codebook/instrument text was not shipped in the workspace, so we report the empirical answer (**BDD_Scenarios** and **MLCanvas**) with the explicit caveat that decimal-level reconciliation with the cited 4.366%/10.13% figures is not possible from this dataset alone.

payload.workflow: 1) Load data/requirements_engineering_for_ML-enabled_systems.csv (276 rows x 202 columns). 2) Treat Q10 '-77' as missing -> Q10-answering N=194 (Status='Suspended (22)' rows were skipped at Q10). 3) Treat each Q10 binary 'quoted' as 1, 'not quoted' as 0. 4) Exclude 'Others' (free-text catch-all) and 'Not_Documented' (meta 'nothing documented' option) when ranking CONCRETE documentation formats. 5) Compute share of valid respondents who quoted each format; 95% percentile bootstrap CI, B = 10,000. 6) Rank concrete formats ascending; verify BDD_Scenarios = 4 and MLCanvas = 15 are the two smallest; Vision_Document = 29 and Goal_Models = 29 tie at rank 3-4 (~10.51% of N=276). 7) Reconciliation: closest to cited 10.13% is Vision_Document/Goal_Models (29/276 = 10.51%); the cited 4.366% has no exact match under either N (closest is BDD_Scenarios 1.45% of 276 / 2.06% of 194). The narrow CI half-widths (~0.2 pp) imply the source paper's specific resampling/weighting, which is not staged in this workspace.

closest_under_N276.to_10_13_pct: Vision_Document / Goal_Models (29/276 = 10.51%, Delta=0.38 pp — closest match).
closest_under_N276.to_4_366_pct: No exact match; BDD_Scenarios 4/276 = 1.45% (Delta=2.92 pp) is the smallest concrete count, still off.

closest_under_N194.to_4_366_pct: No exact match; BDD_Scenarios 4/194 = 2.06% (Delta=2.31 pp), MLCanvas 15/194 = 7.73% (Delta=3.36 pp).

reconciliation_to_cited.note_on_CI_narrowness: SE for a proportion p=0.10 under N=194 is sqrt(p(1-p)/N) = 2.154 pp, giving a normal-approx 95% CI half-width of ~3.5 pp. The reported CI half-widths (~0.13-0.20 pp) are ~15-25x narrower, indicating a process with much larger effective sample size (stratification, weighting, or different resampling unit) than a vanilla respondent-level non-parametric bootstrap can produce from this CSV.
